intro.text: A commanding, composed man with grey hair and spiked eyebrows, who attends Queen Fen and Kmakl.

items.text: On the second of the ten days before the contest of champions, Fladrn told Fen and Kmakl that enemy Skybreakers had broken out in Jah Keved and that the force was moving toward Thaylen City, exploiting a loophole in Dalinar's contract with Odium.

personality.text: Commanding and composed, he doesn't bat an eye at finding Fen and Kmakl unclothed.
